verdict.rationale: The GST portal home page offers a 'Log/Track Your Issues' link for Grievance Redressal, which gives some case-status tracking. A help module also mentions a dashboard for downloading certificates and notices, though that appears to sit behind login. Nothing in the evidence shows a public page for tracking a registration application, return filing, refund, or appeal status. missing for 10: documented public status lookup for registration applications, return/filing status tracking, refund/appeal/case status pages, and hands-on or independent corroboration that status lookups work.
